description: This file defines an exception class for handling errors related to the Amazon Elastic Container Registry Public (ECR Public) service within the AWS SDK for PHP. It extends a generic AWS exception class and is part of the nested namespace structure associated with the ECRPublic service.

classes.name: ECRPublicException
classes.description: A specific exception class that represents errors encountered when interacting with the Amazon ECR Public service. It extends the general AwsException class.
